scopeStatus: Documentation baseline of 290 matrix rows and eleven confirmed supplements; exact target AE release and complete supplemental-category reconciliation remain open.
classificationNote: Provider classifications and engineering prerequisites are planning inferences, not Adobe implementation disclosures. Raw matrix cells retain source spelling/markers; blanks are not interpreted as proof of no support.

statuses.documented-implementation-unverified: Working independent implementation, internal GPU tests, no AE reference comparison.
statuses.partial-existing: Partial independent operator; not a full AE control/behavior match.
statuses.unimplemented: Tracked target; no placeholder registration is added.

prerequisites.controls-and-reference: Pin AE release; capture controls/defaults/ranges/units/groups and compare licensed reference frames. No exact parity is verified yet.
prerequisites.pixel-operator: Implement independent single-frame shader with straight/premultiplied alpha and precision semantics.
prerequisites.spatial-kernel: Implement reviewed neighborhood sampling, edge extension, bounds/padding and resolution-invariant radius.
prerequisites.layer-input: Implemented stable composition-local layer references with Source/Masks/Effects, Composition/Layer Source spaces, typed path/image references, exact shutter-time video and explicit source-sized owners with progressive declared growth. Source owners require supported 2D definitions. External backdrops/matte conversion, groups/3D, calibrated edge conventions and undeclared historical/third-party revisions remain open.
prerequisites.path-input: Implemented typed mask/shape-path IDs, owner-local animated geometry, Stroke v2 hardness/spacing/Start-End/all-mask sequencing, conservative geometry-grown source bounds and bounded brush work. Projected/3D geometry and exact AE calibration remain open.
prerequisites.temporal-input: Implemented bounded timestamp/stage/space/owner-prefix requests with provider-time evaluation, hidden exact reverse video/private preview/repeated precomps, source-extent union, memory/count caps, cancellation and shared native/portable delivery. Echo is a real first consumer. General temporal other-layer references, group/adjustment/3D/backdrops, optical flow and stateful analysis remain open.
prerequisites.analysis: Add cancellable deterministic analysis jobs, durable result channels, reanalysis invalidation and memory budgets.
prerequisites.audio-dsp: Add effect-aware real-time and offline audio graphs, sample-rate/channel/tail semantics and deterministic export.
prerequisites.audio-analysis: Expose sampled audio envelopes/spectrum to rendering with consistent real-time/offline timing.
prerequisites.scene-buffers: Expose depth/normals/object IDs/camera/multiview inputs to effects and their export/player equivalents.
prerequisites.auxiliary-image-channels: Import EXR/auxiliary channel planes and stable channel selectors beyond RGBA textures.
prerequisites.simulation: Add seeded state, seek-order independent checkpoints, time integration and simulation cache invalidation.
prerequisites.sphere-projection: Implement equirectangular/cubemap projection, seam-aware sampling and camera/projection controls.
prerequisites.typed-controller: Add typed point/vector/color/layer/dropdown controller data with expression and Inspector contracts.
prerequisites.color-management: Implemented shared derived D65 RGB/XYZ matrices, signed sRGB/P3 and Rec.2020 display transfer math, fixed named-profile Color Profile Converter and HDR Compander, alongside standalone .cube assets. Project/import/output policy, ICC/OCIO/profile assets, intents/compensation/adaptation and AE calibration remain open.
prerequisites.curve-or-map: Add editable curve/LUT/gradient-map data, interpolation and asset serialization.
prerequisites.text-generator: Add generator typography/font/layout/timecode and export contracts with editable effect controls.
prerequisites.bounds: Implemented progressive source-owner domains, padding and Stroke v2 conservative control-hull bounds with budgeting, cancellation and historical revision preservation. Exact AE bounds, group/backdrop/3D regions and additional geometry contracts remain open.
prerequisites.independent-bundled-equivalent: Research public behavior and independently implement a functional equivalent; no binary extraction, redistribution or assumed license.
prerequisites.external-integration: Define an authorized licensed integration or independent capability; no external software installation is authorized.
prerequisites.legacy-migration: Version effect behavior before changing existing saved effect IDs, channels, units or defaults.
prerequisites.typed-asset-input: Implemented static image and standalone .cube LUT asset IDs, native import controls, bounded parsing/texture budgets, missing/deleted references, persistence/copy/replacement Undo, coalescing remaps and real native/portable consumers. OCIO/ICC/general config, analysis and video asset contracts remain open.

effects.name: Compound Blur
effects.implementationNotes: Independent per-output luminance-driven 2D Gaussian gather. Blur Layer/stage, Maximum Blur, Stretch Map To Fit and Invert Blur are implemented. Internally tested 8/16/32-bit convolution, alpha, edges, transformed density, animated map content, hydration, native H264 and isolated portable playback. Wide kernels use bounded mip-assisted approximation; Composition-space inputs and owner chains retain composition clipping. Kernel/default/working-space parity with a pinned installed AE release is unverified. Explicit source space now retains selected native content before transforms/opacity with local masks/effects. Composition space and historical revisions are retained. Composition-space owner chains remain clipped; declared 2D chains can opt into source owner processing and bounds growth. Opt-in source owner processing now recovers content before composition clipping and declares progressive bounds growth. Composition mode remains historical; exact AE bounds/edge conventions remain unverified.

effects.name: Gaussian Blur

effects.name: Unsharp Mask
effects.implementationNote: Independent spatial implementation and internal GPU fixtures; no AE reference render comparison. See effects-compatibility.md for bounds, averaging and color-space limits.

effects.name: Arithmetic
effects.implementationNotes: Twelve real straight-RGB operators: Add/Subtract/Multiply/Difference/Max/Min/Block Above/Block Below/Screen/And/Or/Xor; per-channel 0–255 values, alpha preservation, clipping and explicit byte wrapping. Bitwise operations quantize to 8-bit; Multiply uses normalized constants. GPU operator math, alpha, hydration, UI Undo and native/portable delivery tested. Slice, control calibration and exact AE wrap/multiply conventions remain unverified.

effects.name: Blend
effects.implementationNotes: Real five-mode Color Only/Tint Only/Darken Only/Lighten Only/Crossfade consumer, animated Blend With Original and Center/Stretch. Premultiplied crossfade includes transparent regions; other modes retain owner alpha and weight by source alpha. HLS transfer retains owner lightness and peak HDR scale. Native stage/space inputs, numeric/HDR/alpha/edge tests, history/copy/deletion/cycle/resource recovery and hidden-video native/portable delivery. Exact AE HLS/alpha weighting/defaults/placement remain reference-unverified.

effects.name: Calculations
effects.implementationNotes: Real RGBA/Gray/R/G/B/Alpha extraction for both inputs; pre-extraction straight-channel/alpha inversion, secondary opacity, nine blend modes, Center/Stretch and Preserve Transparency. Independent premultiplied source-over; None permits first-input extraction and is identity at defaults. Native bounds restrict alpha creation while expanded original content outside remains. GPU math/precision/HDR/alpha, stage/space, lifetime and hidden-video native/portable tests. Full AE blend menu, default/working-space/edge/alpha calibration remain open.

effects.name: Channel Combiner
effects.implementationNotes: Revision 2 appends twelve real multichannel From conversions: RGB/HLS, RGB/HSV, RGB/YIQ, RGB/YUV, linear sRGB/XYZ D65 and RGB/YCbCr709 pairs. Scalar IDs and revision 1 are preserved. To is bypassed for multichannel modes; output Invert/Solid Alpha apply. Floating buffers preserve signed chroma/HDR; HLS is unit-gamut and HSV Value nonnegative HDR. Numeric pair/legacy/native UI/history/portable/native tests. Separate Use 2nd Layer toggle, further conversion/menu/default calibration and licensed AE reference matching remain open.

effects.name: Invert
effects.implementationNotes: Revision 2 implements RGB, HLS, YIQ, individual channels, alpha and Blend With Original. Unversioned/v1 instances retain original amount-based shader. Color-space/gamut conventions remain reference-unverified.

effects.name: Set Channels
effects.implementationNotes: Four independently scheduled source/stage inputs copy Alpha/RGB/Luminance/Full On/Full Off into output RGBA; None uses the current image. Native grouped controls, alpha/HDR, copied-ID remapping and persistence implemented. Input bounds are normalized onto owner bounds; exact AE source mapping, full controls and premultiplication conventions remain unverified. Explicit source space now retains selected native content before transforms/opacity with local masks/effects. Composition space and historical revisions are retained. Composition-space owner chains remain clipped; declared 2D chains can opt into source owner processing and bounds growth.

Set Matte premultiplication conventions and Displacement Map displacement midpoint/edge conventions require AE calibration. Explicit source space now retains selected native content before transforms/opacity with local masks/effects. Composition space and historical revisions are retained. Composition-space owner chains remain clipped; declared 2D chains can opt into source owner processing and bounds growth. Opt-in source owner processing now recovers content before composition clipping and declares progressive bounds growth. Composition mode remains historical; exact AE bounds/edge conventions remain unverified.

effects.name: Shift Channels
effects.implementationNotes: Independent RGBA sourcing from RGBA, luminance, HLS and full-on/off. Alpha-creating output is restricted to transformed source bounds. Reference calibration pending.

effects.name: Solid Composite
effects.implementationNotes: Real premultiplied solid background, source/solid opacity and nine blend modes: Normal, Multiply, Screen, Overlay, Darken, Lighten, Difference, Add, Subtract. Background respects native owner bounds while retaining expanded original content. GPU alpha/edges/HDR/math and chained native H264/isolated portable delivery tested. Full AE blend menu and exact reference parity remain open.

effects.name: Texturize
effects.implementationNotes: Independent height-gradient relief with layer/stage/space, light direction, contrast and tile/center/stretch controls. Real GPU lighting, alpha/HDR, animated controls, source-space clipping, actual H264 and isolated portable tests. Exact AE lighting/kernel/default/placement parity is unverified; no licensed reference frames compared. effects.name: Echo
effects.implementationNote: Real bounded owner-prefix temporal sampling and seven operators, native source/comp coordinates, up to 32 additional samples, numeric control animation, hidden reverse video, history and native/portable output. Independent premultiplied alpha/HDR operators and 0–1 intensity/decay; composition prefix clipping and group/adjustment/3D/backdrop temporal owners remain limited. Exact AE controls/defaults/pixels unverified.

effects.name: Apply Color LUT
effects.implementationNotes: Real standalone .cube asset consumer: 1D linear / 3D trilinear interpolation, DOMAIN_MIN/MAX, unchanged alpha, float table and HDR output, Amount and native Choose LUT. Bounded 16 MiB parser, 1D 2–4096 and 3D 2–64 samples/axis, finite ±65504. Source bytes persist/package/restore with no footage layer. Missing references, copy/save, replacement rejection/Undo, eviction, reload and native/portable output tested. Combined shaper+3D and .3dl/.look/.csp/OCIO/ICC remain unsupported; input domains clamp. Exact AE defaults/interpolation/overrange/working-space parity unverified.

effects.name: Color Profile Converter
effects.implementationNotes: Real fixed D65 profile transform among sRGB, Display P3 and Rec.2020 display gamma2.4, deriving RGB/XYZ matrices from chromaticities and using signed extended transfers. Input/output linearization, Clip Output and Amount; exact default identity, premultiplied alpha and unclipped floating HDR. Numeric reference/CPU-GPU/native UI/history/budget/cancel/context/H264/isolated portable acceptance. Not ICC/OCIO or project-wide color management; arbitrary profile assets, intents, black-point/scene compensation, white-point adaptation and exact AE calibration remain unimplemented.

effects.name: HDR Compander
effects.implementationNotes: Real signed power compression and reciprocal expansion controlled by Gain/Gamma, with alpha preservation and exact Gain=Gamma=1 identity. CPU/GPU range and round-trip, signed HDR/edges, history/copy/budget/cancel/context, native UI and actual native/portable tests. Independent power curve/defaults/ranges, not AE-reference-calibrated; intermediate precision/clipping/overflow still matters.
